skill.name: tester
skill.description: Design and run testing workflows for a React and Django application, including Playwright, pytest, UAT, smoke tests, and reports.
skill.summary: Guides full-stack test planning, execution, failure analysis, and reporting for GabeDA.
skill.author: Brownbull

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, localhost URLs, relative imports, CI flags, and mocked examples. Confirmed risk remains around persistent Playwright auth storage, embedded sample credentials, and absolute output paths. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: Persistent Playwright auth state may contain cookies or tokens.
remediation.suggestion: Store storage state only for test accounts, add tests/.auth to .gitignore, and delete the file after test runs.

remediation.issue: Reference examples include reusable sample credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use fixtures, environment-provided test values, or generated accounts instead of fixed email and password strings.

remediation.issue: Output guidance includes absolute Windows project paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer workspace-relative paths and require explicit approval before writing outside the repository.

remediation.issue: Local test commands can execute project scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for confirmation before running npm, pytest, or coverage commands in unfamiliar repositories.

content.value_statement: Complex full-stack releases need consistent test plans and clear failure reports. This skill guides Playwright, pytest, smoke, integration, and UAT workflows for GabeDA.
actual_capabilities: Plans unit, integration, smoke, E2E, and UAT test coverage for GabeDA features.
Drafts Playwright tests for React user flows and browser-based checks.
Drafts pytest tests for Django APIs, models, serializers, and services.
Runs documented frontend and backend test commands when the environment is available.
Summarizes failures, coverage gaps, reproduction steps, and recommended fixes.
Creates test strategy, report, and finding documents in the project testing folders.
limitations: The guidance is tailored to the GabeDA project structure and naming conventions.
Execution depends on installed dependencies, working services, and valid local test data.
Some examples use localhost URLs and sample credentials that must be replaced safely.
It does not guarantee complete coverage without current feature requirements.

use_cases.title: Plan release validation
use_cases.description: Create a balanced test strategy that covers smoke checks, UAT scenarios, integration risks, and release reporting.

use_cases.title: Add feature tests
use_cases.description: Generate Playwright and pytest cases for a new React and Django workflow before code review.

use_cases.title: Triage failing suites
use_cases.description: Turn frontend and backend test failures into clear findings, likely causes, and recommended next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a smoke test checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a smoke test checklist for the GabeDA login, dashboard, company creation, upload, and reporting paths.

prompt_templates.title: Write Playwright coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Write Playwright test cases for the company switcher flow. Include setup data, assertions, and cleanup notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build backend pytest cases
prompt_templates.prompt: Create pytest coverage for the file upload API. Include valid uploads, invalid formats, authorization checks, and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a failed release run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these frontend and backend test results. Identify root causes, missing coverage, and a prioritized remediation plan.

output_examples.input: Create smoke tests for login, dashboard access, and file upload.
output: A smoke test plan grouped by critical path and dependency.
Frontend and backend checks with expected outcomes.
A short report template for pass, fail, blocked, and follow-up items.

output_examples.input: Investigate why the company switcher E2E test is failing.
output: A failure summary with observed behavior and affected workflow.
Likely causes such as missing test data, stale selectors, or async timing.
Recommended fixes and focused rerun steps.

output_examples.input: Design UAT for the upload feature.
output: Business-facing acceptance scenarios for valid, invalid, and large files.
Required test data and stakeholder review checkpoints.
Exit criteria for approval or release blocking.

best_practices: Use isolated test accounts, fixtures, and cleanup for every generated test.
Prefer stable role, label, or test ID selectors over brittle CSS or index selectors.
Record failures with reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and owner-ready recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not copy sample passwords or tokens into committed tests.
Do not rely on fixed waits when Playwright can wait for state or responses.
Do not write reports or tests outside the active workspace without explicit approval.

faq.question: What applications is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for GabeDA, a React frontend and Django backend application.

faq.question: Can it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It can run documented local commands when dependencies, services, and user permissions are available.

faq.question: Does it create both frontend and backend tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Playwright browser tests and pytest coverage for Django components.

faq.question: Where does it place reports?
faq.answer: It uses the project testing report folders described by the skill, preferably as workspace-relative paths.

faq.question: Does it replace QA review?
faq.answer: No. It prepares tests and reports, but stakeholders must review UAT results and release decisions.

faq.question: How should credentials be handled?
faq.answer: Use test-only fixtures or environment-provided values, and avoid committing passwords, tokens, or browser storage files.
